one_liner: Vonage offers self-serve REST communications APIs (SMS, Voice, Messages, Verify, etc.) with API key/secret and JWT auth, free signup credit, and official MCP servers.
auth_notes: Account-level API key/secret (Basic header or legacy params) and application-signed JWT (self-minted with private key). OAuth exists only for Vonage Business Communications APIs (gated) and CAMARA network APIs; no user-authorization flow for the main API.
access_notes: Free signup gives API key/secret, €2 test credit, and DEMO mode (up to 10 destination numbers). Production needs added credit. RCS requires managed-customer onboarding; VBC APIs require 50+ extensions and a CSM.
blocker_notes: Free account gives working credentials with demo credit; the VBC and RCS sub-products are gated but the core APIs are not.

evidence.quote: Basic Authentication sends your API Key and API Secret **Base64-encoded** in the `Authorization` header.
Vonage APIs (Voice, Messages, Conversation, etc) use JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication. JWTs must be signed with the private key of your application.
When you create your Vonage account you are given €2 free test credit and your account is set in DEMO mode.
Ensure your organization has 50 extensions or more.
also known as the Tooling MCP Server, lets you invoke various API actions directly through your LLM Assistant or IDE of choice.
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that provides AI assistants with access to Vonage API documentation, code snippets, tutorials, and troubleshooting resources.
`neru-mcp` runs on VCR and is available as a remote endpoint — no local installation is required.
